unit.title: Funerals
unit.needIt: Knowing funeral manners helps you support a grieving friend without making things awkward. It ensures you provide comfort instead of adding stress during a hard time.
unit.why: Imagine a friend loses a parent. They are overwhelmed and exhausted. By following simple rules, like staying quiet and not forcing your presence, you act as a shield that lets them rest.
unit.outcome: Provide respectful support to others during a time of loss.
unit.reachesYou: You might see this when a neighbor loses a loved one or a coworker passes away. It helps you know what to say and how to act when everyone feels uncomfortable.
unit.do: If a friend is grieving, send a short note of sympathy instead of calling them to ask for a long conversation.

quiz.q: What is the main goal of etiquette during a funeral?
quiz.why: The text states that all rules for social observance aim to smooth personal contacts.
quiz.quote: All set rules for social observance have for their object the smoothing of personal contacts, and in nothing is smoothness so necessary as in observing the solemn rites accorded our dead.

quiz.q: Who should be barred from the bereaved during a time of grief?
quiz.why: The text says over-emotional people should be kept away to protect the grieving.
quiz.quote: No one should ever be forced upon those in grief, and all over-emotional people, no matter how near or dear, should be barred absolutely.

quiz.q: What kind of food is best for someone in deep sorrow?
quiz.why: The palate rejects the thought of food, so only a very little should be offered.
quiz.quote: The cook may suggest something that appeals usually to their taste, but very little should be offered at a time, for although the stomach may be empty, the palate rejects the thought of food, and digestion is never in best order.

quiz.q: What should a friend do if they see a person in deep mourning?
quiz.why: The text suggests a brief gesture of sympathy rather than long conversation.
quiz.quote: If you pass close to them, irresistible sympathy compels you merely to stop and press their hand and pass on.

quiz.q: What is the rule for sending cards to intimate friends?
quiz.why: The text says cards should not be sent to intimate friends who have already reached out.
quiz.quote: Under no circumstances should such cards be sent to intimate friends, or to those who have sent flowers or written personal letters.

partials: Etiquette acts as a servant to keep the house quiet.
It protects the bereaved from over-emotional people.
It ensures the rites are performed with beauty and gravity.
It helps smooth out personal contacts during sorrow.
It allows the poignancy of grief to be eased.
crystal.key: Etiquette serves as a protective shield that provides order and comfort during the chaos of death.

decoys.text: Etiquette is about following strict rules to show off your status.
decoys.why: The text says etiquette is for smoothing contacts and providing comfort, not for status.

decoys.text: You should always call a grieving person to check on them.
decoys.why: The text says to avoid long conversations and to let them have seclusion.

crystal.aha: By following these rules, you remove the burden of social guesswork from the grieving person.
